units.source_text: 此外尚有种种话语，读者当可想象。

en.t: There were many other words as well, which the reader may well imagine.

units.source_text: 左大臣及乳母宰相君处，亦有信送去，托他们多多照顾小公子。

en.t: Letters were also sent to the Minister of the Left and to his nurse, Saisho no Kimi, asking them to take good care of the young prince.
